name: Subdocument
description: Represents a subdocument within a document or range. The Subdocument object is a member of the Subdocuments collection. The Subdocuments collection includes all the subdocuments in the a range or document.
remarks: Use Subdocuments (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Subdocument object. The following example displays the path and file name of the first subdocument in the active document. Use the AddFromFile or AddFromRange method to add a subdocument to a document. The following example adds a subdocument named "Setup.doc" at the end of the active document. The following example applies the Heading 1 style to the first paragraph in the selection and then creates a subdocument for the contents of the selection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Subdocument object.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: True if a subdocument in a master document is locked. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that's contained within the subdocument.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the specified object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns the disk or Web path to the specified subdocument. Read-only String.

properties.name: HasFile
properties.description: True if the specified subdocument has been saved to a file. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Level
properties.description: Returns the heading level used to create the subdocument. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Divides an existing subdocument into two subdocuments at the same level in master document view or outline view.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range that, when the subdocument is split, becomes a separate subdocument.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the specified subdocument. Returns a Document object that represents the opened subdocument.
